messages.package.name: Calendar
messages.package.description: The office agenda, agnostic: any extension puts an item on it and stays its owner.
messages.package.summary: The office agenda in day columns, with the whole month on a single scroll that opens on today. It knows nothing about deadlines, hearings or instalments: any extension registers an item, stays its owner and decides what happens when someone drags it to another day.

messages.point.move.description: The action executed when an item is dragged to another day. What the change means is decided by the origin.
messages.settings.section.title: Calendar
messages.settings.section.description: How the agenda answers what the user does.
messages.settings.move-actions: When an item is dragged to another day
messages.settings.move-actions.description: The actions that answer a change of day, in the order they are consulted. The first one that serves the item origin wins — dragging writes nothing on its own.
messages.overview.body:
The **Calendar** shows the days of the month side by side and what is scheduled on each one. The scroll opens on today, the card is coloured by priority, and the legend below filters by it in one click.

The agenda owns nothing it shows. Each item belongs to the record that created it — a deadline, a hearing, an instalment — and it is that record that keeps it current: changed there, changed here; deleted there, gone from here. That is why an item is not edited from the agenda, and why clicking the card goes straight to the origin record.

Dragging a card to another day **asks** the extension that owns the item what to do. In Settings › Calendar you choose which ones answer, and in what order.

messages.overview.body:
O **Calendário** mostra, lado a lado, os dias do mês e o que está marcado em cada um. A rolagem abre no dia de hoje, o cartão é colorido pela prioridade e a legenda embaixo filtra por ela num clique.

A agenda não é dona de nada do que mostra. Cada item pertence ao registro que o criou — um prazo, uma audiência, uma parcela — e é esse registro que o mantém em dia: mudou lá, muda aqui; foi excluído lá, some daqui. Por isso o item não se edita pela agenda, e clicar no cartão leva direto ao registro de origem.

Arrastar um cartão para outro dia **pergunta** à extensão dona do item o que fazer. Em Configurações › Calendário você escolhe quais respondem e em que ordem.
